messages:
Ben Ortiz: Quick thread 1: candidate Amina Elhassan (based Nairobi, GMT+3) accepted onsite interview in London on Mon May 18. She prefers company-arranged travel + single-night hotel due to late arrival. Also asked about visa letter and local transit reimbursement. Can TravelOps/Finance confirm policy and next steps? @Priya Singh can you draft the travel invite + escort note?

Priya Singh: Thanks Ben. I can own candidate comms and escort note. Quick Q: does Redwood cover visas for international interviews or just relocation interviews? Also need preferred class (economy) and booking name (matches passport). Ben, can you confirm passport name + earliest arrival/departure windows?

Ben Ortiz: Passport name = Amina Fatima Elhassan. Arrival: May 17 evening (flight lands 21:30 local), needs hotel that night and interview day May 18 (09:30-15:00). Return May 19 morning. Prefers economy. She asked if we can pre-pay transit from Gatwick to hotel1.

TravelOps (bot): Redwood travel policy (summary): - Interview travel: company covers standard economy flights + one night hotel when arrival is outside 3 hours before start time. - Visa letters: provided on request for visa appointments (non-sponsored). - Local transit reimbursement: up to 50 GBP on receipt. Steps: 1) TravelOps to book flight and hotel after recruiter confirmation. 2) Finance to issue pre-paid hotel or supply booking link. 3) Provide visa invite letter if candidate requests. Reply with APPROVE to proceed.

Finance: APPROVE to proceed. We will book hotel directly and charge to recruiting budget. For transit, we can pre-authorize a 50 GBP expense; candidate must submit receipts within 30 days for reimbursement or we can provide an on-arrival cab voucher if preferred. For VAT paperwork, provide invoice name: Redwood Inference Ltd.

Marta Kowalska (Hiring Manager): We can cover travel. Please make hotel <10 min from office; quiet room requested. Interviewers: SRE team confirmed (Marta, Liam, Zoe), take-home laptop test waived for onsite. Also please include an office tour and a short intro lunch with Marta.

Priya Singh: Booking notes: use passport name Amina Fatima Elhassan. Book outbound May 17 evening, return May 19 morning. Hotel: 1 night (May 17), request ground-floor or elevator access (candidate mentioned minor mobility issue). I'll ask for a mobility-friendly room. Ben, will DM candidate to confirm ID scan and whether she wants a pre-paid transit voucher vs reimbursement.

Ben Ortiz: DM sent at 09:14; candidate responded prefers voucher. She also requested a visa letter for her UK appointment next week.

TravelOps (bot): Action list created: - Book economy roundtrip (NBO-LON) May 17-19 (booker: TravelOps) - Reserve 1 night hotel near office, request accessible room (booker: TravelOps) - Issue transit voucher 50 GBP (Facilities/Front Desk) - Generate visa invitation letter (Priya) - Send calendar invites + airport pickup note (Priya)

Facilities: We can provide a pre-paid cab voucher to be collected at reception. Hotel recommendations: The Dockside Hotel (8 min walk) or Riverway Suites (5 min, elevator). Reception will print voucher under candidate name.

Finance: Please use cost center RECR-INTL-2026. We'll need candidate's invoice or sign-off form for VAT reclaim.

Priya Singh: Visa invite letter drafted and emailed to Amina at 10:02. TravelOps, please proceed with booking and share itinerary once confirmed. I'll add escort and accessibility notes to calendar invites and include voucher pick-up instructions.

TravelOps (bot): Booking in progress. Tentative itinerary will be posted here when booked. Please confirm if we should secure flexible tickets (add £60 change fee) or standard (cheaper).

Ben Ortiz: Go with standard economy. If flight changes, we'll handle case-by-case. Thanks team.

Priya Singh: All set for now 1 I will post final itinerary and calendar invites in this thread once TravelOps confirms booking. If anyone else needs to join the lunch intro (Martas team), ping me.

Marta Kowalska: I'll join lunch. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

TravelOps (bot): Flight + hotel confirmed at 12:45. Itinerary link: https://travel.redwood.internal/itineraries/abc123 (internal). Sending calendar invites to Amina and interviewers now. Voucher code: RECV-TRV-657 (collect at reception).

Priya Singh: Invites sent at 12:52 with itinerary and voucher pickup instructions. Marking this thread complete.
